content:
The **Brotherhood Recon Rifle** is a Non-Automatic Rifle in *Fallout 76*. It is a regular hunting Rifle with a custom name and prefab modification loadout.

## Gameplay[edit]

The Brotherhood Recon Rifle is a fully modified Hunting Rifle crafted for the base resources of an unmodified Hunting Rifle. The stats of the Brotherhood Recon Rifle are the same as a Hunting Rifle with the same modification configuration.

## Locations[edit]

The Brotherhood Recon Rifle must be crafted by the player character. The ability to craft the weapon is unlocked by choosing the New Registration option on the Artillery battery terminal, located outside Fort Defiance on the player character's right when facing the doors to enter Fort Defiance. The terminal requires the Military ID Card to unlock it.

For a full list of possible modifications, see Hunting Rifle.
